lines.zh: 我踏过的草地，都安静了。
lines.en: The grass I tread on falls silent.

lines.zh: 你跑不掉的，我知道方向。
lines.en: You can't escape; I know the way.

lines.zh: 隔着百二十格，我也会来。
lines.en: Past a hundred and twenty blocks, I still come.

lines.zh: 我离你总是差那么几步。
lines.en: I'm always a few steps behind you.
Night is my road; by day I sleep.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，血雨将至。
lines.en: Where I walk, blood rain follows.

lines.zh: 你听见脚步了吗？那是我。

lines.en: Closing in slowly makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我正在缩短我们之间的距离。
lines.en: I'm shortening the distance between us.

lines.zh: 我不动，比动起来更让你难受。
lines.en: Me standing still hurts you more than moving would.
I wait for you to slacken.

lines.zh: 安静，让我听听你的呼吸。

lines.en: I stand still and the blood rain falls.
I'm not rushed; you'll move first.
Staring at air, and at you.
When you sleep, I'll be at your bedside.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，别装作没看见。
我数着你的心跳，比我的慢。
lines.en: I count your heartbeat; it is slower than mine.
Come a little closer, won't you?

lines.zh: 我们之间，只剩这点距离。
你跑起来的样子，真好看。
lines.en: You look lovely when you run.
Don't blink; blink and I'm there.
What number are you at? I'm nearly here.
The blood rain is about to fall.
You're at your bed; so am I.
The boiled shell cracked—I'm still here.
Pain? I forgot it long ago.
Hit me again and I'll close in.

lines.zh: 食物？我追的从来不是这个。
lines.en: Food? That's not what I hunt.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我也照样靠近。

lines.en: Don't bait me with food; I'm not hungry.

lines.zh: 我只要你的视线和恐惧。
lines.en: I only want your gaze and your fear.

lines.zh: 这味道留不住我的脚步。
lines.en: That scent won't hold my steps.
I don't eat; I just follow.

lines.zh: 你以为喂饱我就安全了？
lines.en: Think feeding me keeps you safe?

lines.zh: 走开，别挡在我和你之间。
lines.en: Move—don't stand between me and you.

lines.zh: 那点东西，换不来我的离开。

lines.en: I'm staring at you, not that.
You step back; I step forward.

lines.zh: 碰撞也是接触，我不介意。
lines.en: Collision is contact; I don't mind.
Bump me again and I'll lunge.

lines.zh: 这么近，你闻得到焦味吗？
lines.en: This close, can you smell the scorch?
Move—the path I walk is you.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，这不是亲近。
lines.en: Don't come this close—this isn't affection.
I was made only to follow you.

lines.zh: 这具身体不繁殖，只逼近。
lines.en: This body doesn't breed; it closes in.

lines.zh: 我不需要同类，只需要你怕。
lines.en: I need no kin—just your fear.
Back off; I only understand chasing.
Blood rain is far more interesting.
I don't pick up things—I pick up people.
Objects on the ground mean nothing to me.

lines.zh: 拾取？我的手只用来抓你。
lines.en: Pick up? My hands are only for grabbing you.
What you drop, I walk over.
Don't expect me to hold it for you.

lines.zh: 我只带走恐惧，不带走物品。

lines.en: Leave that thing on the ground.
I've no interest in your belongings.
Bend down? I only stoop for you.
Picking it up won't save you.

lines.zh: 你回头时，我已经更近了。
lines.en: When you look back, I'm closer.

lines.zh: 从这一刻起，你被跟着了。
我被煮过一次，就不需要理由。
lines.en: I was boiled once, so I need no reason.
Don't stop; stopping brings me closer.
A hundred and twenty blocks isn't far.

lines.zh: 血雨在你头顶聚起来了。
lines.en: A rain of blood is gathering over your head.

lines.zh: 你跑出百二十格，我还在。
lines.en: Run a hundred and twenty blocks; I am still here.
The farther you run, the closer I get.
You count steps; I count you.
When you're at your bed, I'll be there.
The more afraid you are, the clearer I see.
When you decide to run, it's too late.
The feel of this boiled shell coming down.
My palm is heavier than the night.
This one's payment for the tracking.
How many breaths have you left?
My fist is prepared only for you.
The fear cuts deeper than the wound.
Don't look for me—I'll come closer.

lines.zh: 你听见远处的脚步声了吗？

lines.en: The smell of blood rain arrives first.
I begin walking from the dark.
Don't shut the door—I get in.
Falling only hardens the boiled shell.

lines.zh: 水淹不死我，我早被煮透了。
lines.en: Water won't drown me—I was boiled through.
In the blast smoke, I still walk.

lines.zh: 箭矢钉在焦皮上，像装饰。
lines.en: Arrows stick in the boiled skin like ornaments.
The lightning only outlines my shape.
